summary: Confirmed all 57 requested estimates plus the S1 study entry and c006 paper-level supplement changes (59 entries). Read the complete supplement markdown (1,515 lines) and main-paper markdown (362 lines), including appendices. Checked the cited PDF pages with PyMuPDF text extraction and recovered the numerical tables with find_tables(). The coefficients, standard errors, means, SD, significance bounds, test statistics, percentages, counts, arm assignments, analysis specifications and requested codes are supported. An independent table-cell/count comparison completed 511 checks without a mismatch; all recorded numerical fields have a single source. The flagged preregistration quotations are visibly printed on supplement PDF p. 77, Section 9, question 5. Their failed automated matches are caused by the corrupted PDF text layer, not incorrect quotations or page locators; the page was rendered and inspected in memory. The preregistration supports primary novelty/usefulness indices, robustness specifications and component items, exploratory emotional outcomes, and the absence of similarity outcomes. Reviewed the 277-entry supplement_changes log and confirmed 248 applicable current fields against their logged new values. No pre-existing main-text numerical field was changed. In particular, the main-text anchoring coefficients 4.29 and 4.11 remain intact; the supplement values 4.288 and 4.105 are documented in notes. The conditional pooling departure and other paper-level inconsistencies are already documented in the extraction and require no new verification problem.
